name: treasury-analyst-skills
description: A career-portable library of Claude Code Agent Skills: decision science, safety and reliability, writing and communication, collaboration, data analytics and BI, machine learning, coding agents and personas, learning science, math foundations, continuous improvement, and deep research. Every skill both does the task and teaches the reasoning.

plugins.name: data-analytics-bi-skills
plugins.description: Statistical inference done honestly, causal inference (DAGs, DiD/IV/RDD), A/B test design (SRM, peeking, MDE, variance reduction), survey and sampling design (total survey error, nonresponse), spreadsheet modeling discipline, and assertion-evidence presentations with a build-and-lint toolchain.

plugins.name: data-tools-skills
plugins.description: Hands-on data plumbing that survives real files: DuckDB local analytics with a null-key-guarded reconciliation pattern, PDF table extraction hardened against full-width headings and dateless rows, REST API pulls with bounded pagination and per-request credentials, CSV/flat-file wrangling, and data-file hygiene.

plugins.name: machine-learning-skills
plugins.description: Applied machine learning with honest evaluation: project framing (the leanest model is no model), supervised modeling, feature engineering, model evaluation (threshold as a fitted parameter), time-series forecasting with horizon-aware backtest sizing and measured interval coverage, and anomaly detection with the degenerate-case floor.

plugins.name: continuous-improvement-skills
plugins.description: The improvement methods with teeth: DMAIC with a fully worked control-chart project (provisional-limits discipline included), FMEA with the evidence-gated Action Priority table, measurement systems analysis extended to LLM-as-judge gauge studies, design of experiments, evolutionary operation (EVOP), root cause analysis, and the project command center doctrine.

plugins.name: full-stack-dev-skills
plugins.description: Full-stack application development with a lean-code philosophy: architecture, FastAPI backends, databases/ORM, modern dynamic frontends, realtime features, ML in production, testing strategy, deployment, and evidence-based UI/UX inspection with severity-rated findings and human-factors instruments (Fitts, NASA-TLX).

plugins.name: coding-agent-skills
plugins.description: Claude Code craft for working engineers: authoring Agent Skills (the library's own standard), prompt engineering with the injection-defense doctrine, git/code review with run-verified agent traps, the Board of Advisors multi-agent code review (board-review + six specialist subagents), defect-epidemiology (treat a confirmed bug as evidence about a population), rule-stress-testing, software-archaeology, Comrade Engineer's pencil pass, The Foreman's draw inspection, and Chicken Little (Aether) — the multi-domain persona with forward-deployed advisor and compiler autopsy modes.

plugins.name: metacognition-skills
plugins.description: Composed meta-cognition suite: hierarchical memory management, reflective learning, adaptive analysis, and knowledge crystallization for cumulative improvement across sessions.

plugins.name: deep-research-skills
plugins.description: True deep research skills that go beyond surface search: extensive multi-database literature investigation, cross-domain dot-connection, source-provenance control, evidence appraisal, and citation verification. Starting with medical-research-detective for published medical literature.

plugins.name: writing-skills
plugins.description: Writing registers and explanation craft: adams-smart-brevity (Adams + Axios Smart Brevity for professional, technical, legal, and clinical writing, with the risk-allocation carve-outs and the where-the-bar-disagrees register), adams-plain-grade (5th-8th grade accessible register with the discretion/obligation check), explanation-design (audience models, break-point-marked analogies, the Feynman loop, teach-back), and technical-documentation (Diataxis routing, ADRs, and the owner/cadence/last-verified discipline that keeps a page true).

plugins.name: safety-and-reliability-skills
plugins.description: Safety engineering for records, alarms, and dormant protections: split-tally evidence design with the litigation-hold rail, detection-system tuning by empirical disposition audit (floor-ceiling autoimmunity band), reliability math including probability-of-failure-on-demand for dormant protective functions, rebuild rehearsal with an irreversibility screen, break-glass playbooks, and hash-rank sortition review.

plugins.name: collaboration-skills
plugins.description: Two collaboration instruments that earn their slots: disarming-elicitation (the FBI counter-elicitation stance inverted for willing experts, with the scoped-promise and investigation rails) and meeting-design (decisions extracted as owner-and-date read-backs, not vibes).

plugins.name: math-foundations-skills
plugins.description: Unit conversion and dimensional analysis — the factor-label method, unit checks as a necessary-not-sufficient guard on every formula, and the unit-driven catch for formula rearrangement errors. The broader basic-math set is archived; this is the one that catches real errors models and humans both make.

plugins.name: decision-science-skills
plugins.description: Decision discipline under uncertainty: pre-mortem (with the counsel rail), tabletop wargaming and no-win drills under full exercise control, weak-signal navigation with cue-graded confidence, Bayesian updating via natural frequencies, reference-class forecasting, competing hypotheses analysis, minority-report dissent capture, the Rashomon-effect protocol for conflicting recollections, and The Challenger.
